title: About Artificia
h1: We build with AI, *and we teach it.*
meta_title: About Artificia: AI automation in Vadodara | Artificia AI
meta_description: Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd builds AI automation and business software, trains corporate teams and runs AI courses in Vadodara. Founded by Vijay Linju Raghavan.

fields.statement: We build AI systems, then teach your team to use them.
fields.before_text: AI ideas, but no one to build them?
fields.after_text: Built, running and taught to your team.
fields.subheading: Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd builds AI automation and business software, trains teams to use it, and runs AI courses.

fields.text: The people who *build* our systems also *teach* our classes.

fields.heading: One team. *Three lines of work.*
fields.intro: What we learn building systems for clients goes straight into how we train teams and teach our classes.

cards.title: We build *AI systems for businesses.*
cards.text: AI automation, agentic AI, software and apps, marketing automation, SEO/AEO/GEO and private AI. It starts with a free AI consultation.

cards.title: We train *corporate teams.*
cards.text: AI training built around your own documents and departments, on-site or online.

cards.title: We teach *individuals.*
cards.text: The AI Masterclass: offline in Vadodara, one hour a day, for 30 or 60 days. No coding needed.

fields.heading: Five rules we *work by.*
fields.intro: They apply to every system we build and every team we train.

cards.title: Problem first
cards.text: We start with the work that slows you down. The tool comes second.

cards.title: Built to run
cards.text: Systems are tested before launch and monitored after it.

cards.title: Your accounts, your data
cards.text: We set systems up in your company's own accounts, with private or self-hosted AI where it fits.

cards.title: Your team, trained
cards.text: We train your people to use what we build, so it gets used.

cards.title: Yours to keep
cards.text: You own everything we build, and it keeps running after the project ends.

items.name: Vijay Linju Raghavan
items.bio: Vijay brings a background in film and photography, an economics degree from MSU Baroda, and experience founding tech and e-commerce ventures.

fields.heading: Tell us what you want *to do with AI.*
fields.intro: We will point you to the right solution, training or course, and reply on WhatsApp.
